facts: Parties: Lowther Robotics Ltd (Company) and Merrion Systems Securities (Underwriter).
Clause 4: the Company grants the Underwriters an option to purchase up to 3,200,000 additional shares (the Over-allotment Option), representing 15% of the 16,000,000 Firm Shares.
Clause 3: the Company shall pay the Underwriters a commission of 7.0% of the gross proceeds of the Offering (10,000,000 shares at $22.00 per share), being $17,710,000.
Issuer: Lowther Robotics Ltd. The date of this Prospectus is 10 March 2026.
Use of Proceeds: net proceeds of $150,000,000 will be applied as follows: repayment of the revolving facility $68,000,000; capital expenditure $45,000,000; general corporate purposes $42,000,000.
Legal Proceedings: the Company is not party to any legal proceedings which may have a significant effect on its financial position.
Item 3: the board discussed a class action filed by Kingsmere Engineering Ltd seeking $20,000,000 in damages. Counsel assesses the claim as having reasonable prospects.
